lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectangular grid where spots function as high-intensity nodes within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single linear feature is visible at the dorsal-most portion of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the upper surface and a distinct shadow line beneath.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark, circular focal lesion is visible at the posterior base of the pectoral fin where it meets the flank. The trailing edge of the pectoral fin exhibits irregular serration and loss of tissue consistency.
